connectedAccountsLead: Official OAuth connections for this organization and workspace. Tokens stay on the server. SAFE MODE is the default — publish and send require approval.
connectFailed: Could not start the official connection.
socialHubLead: Campaigns, drafts, calendar, and publish status. External publishing happens only through official APIs after approval.
emailHubLead: AI-assisted business email campaigns and drafts. This is not a Gmail or Outlook clone.
emailNotClone: Official Google OAuth. Read and draft when connected. Sending stays off until you enable it, approve the action, and Gmail confirms.
commandCenterLead: Describe a business goal. AGXORA will create a plan that waits for approval. It will not publish or send until you authorize it.
runFailed: Could not create the agent run.
gmailDenied: Gmail access was denied. Nothing was connected.
gmailError: Gmail connection failed. Nothing was marked connected.
safeModeActive: SAFE MODE is active. Sending requires explicit approval and Gmail confirmation.
subject: Subject
emailExamples: Examples: Check my emails from today. Draft a response. Prepare replies to urgent emails. Send stays blocked until you approve.
youtubePublishSupported: YouTube video publish is supported through the official upload API after approval. Publish permission stays off by default. Scheduling and analytics are not implemented.
safeModePublish: SAFE MODE is active. Publishing requires explicit approval and YouTube confirmation.
publishPermissionOff: Publish permission is off. Enable it on Connected accounts before publishing.
providerUnavailable: This provider is not implemented yet.
amazonHubLead: 连接您的 Amazon Seller 账户，以便 AGXORA 查看您的商品、库存和销售。AGXORA 不会在 Amazon 上购物或下单。
amazonReadOnly: 连接后，AGXORA 可以查看您的 Amazon 商品、库存和销售。暂不支持更改价格、库存或商品信息。
amazonAdsOutOfScope: Amazon 广告是独立的未来模块，目前不可用。
amazonExamples: Examples: Analyze my Amazon sales. Which products are selling best? Which products have low inventory? Show me my Amazon products. Which listings need attention?
amazonDenied: Amazon 访问被拒绝。未建立任何连接。
amazonError: Amazon 连接失败。未标记为已连接。
amazonSafeMode: SAFE MODE 已启用。Amazon 商业更改仍被阻止。
analyzeAmazon: 分析 Amazon 卖家数据
noAmazonData: 尚未加载 Amazon 卖家数据。
amazonHumanVerification: 连接前，Amazon 可能要求您验证企业身份。该步骤在 Amazon 完成，而不是在 AGXORA 内。
amazonSandboxMode: 此环境使用 Amazon 官方测试端点。这不是生产卖家数据。
amazonReadyConnected: 此工作区已连接 Amazon Seller。
